quests.instruction: What fruit is crisp and juicy, with smooth skin that can be red, green or yellow?
quests.hint: A core with small seeds sits in its middle.
quests.explanation: Apples are round, crunchy fruits with smooth skin. An orange has a thick peel and a banana is long and curved.
quests.funFact: Apple trees bloom in spring, and each blossom can turn into an apple.

quests.instruction: Dinner arrives in a bowl, steaming so hot you have to blow on it, and you eat it with a spoon. What is it?
quests.hint: It is mostly liquid, with pieces floating in it.
quests.explanation: Soup is made by simmering ingredients in broth or water. A salad is cold and a sandwich is eaten with your hands.
quests.funFact: Almost every country has a traditional soup, from Italian minestrone to Japanese miso.

quests.instruction: Which orange-fleshed food grows underground and tastes sweet when it is baked?
quests.hint: Its skin is reddish-brown and a little rough.
quests.explanation: A sweet potato is a root that stores sugar, so it tastes sweet once cooked. Corn grows on a cob and a tomato grows on a vine.
quests.funFact: Sweet potatoes are not close relatives of regular potatoes.

quests.instruction: Which protein food swims in oceans and rivers before it ends up on a plate?
quests.hint: It has scales and fins.
quests.explanation: Fish live in water. Chicken and eggs come from farm birds, which live on land.
quests.funFact: People catch fish in the sea and in rivers, and they also raise them on fish farms.

quests.instruction: Rolled oats simmering in a pot turn into which warm breakfast?
quests.hint: It gets thick and creamy as it cooks.
quests.explanation: Oatmeal is made from oats, a grain. Cooking them in water or milk makes them soft and creamy.
quests.funFact: Oats are a cereal grain that grows on tall, grassy plants.

quests.instruction: Name the sweet tropical fruit that has orange-yellow flesh around one big, flat seed.
quests.hint: It grows on tall trees in warm places.
quests.explanation: A mango has juicy flesh wrapped around a single large seed. A banana has no big seed, and a strawberry has tiny ones on its skin.
quests.funFact: The mango is the national fruit of India.

quests.instruction: At a picnic, which food is a sausage tucked into a long, soft bun?
quests.hint: Mustard and ketchup are popular toppings.
quests.explanation: A hot dog uses a long bun that fits the shape of a sausage. A burger needs a round bun and pizza has no bun.
quests.funFact: Sausages are made by packing seasoned chopped meat into a thin casing.

quests.instruction: Which leafy green is the crisp base of many salads and sandwiches?
quests.hint: Its leaves are thin and a little ruffled.
quests.explanation: Lettuce is a vegetable made of leaves, so it adds crunch and freshness. Carrots are roots and corn is a kernel.
quests.funFact: Lettuce leaves are mostly water, which is why they crunch when you bite them.

quests.instruction: What do you get when you press fruit until its liquid runs out?
quests.hint: It tastes like the fruit it came from.
quests.explanation: Juice is the liquid squeezed from fruit. Milk comes from animals and tea is made from leaves.
quests.funFact: It takes several oranges to make a single glass of fresh orange juice.

quests.instruction: A grown-up slices a round vegetable with many papery layers, and suddenly everyone's eyes water. What is it?
quests.hint: Peeling it is a bit like unwrapping layers.
quests.explanation: An onion is made of layers. Cutting it releases a gas that stings our eyes and makes them water.
quests.funFact: The sting from a cut onion comes from a gas that tickles our eyes, so they make tears to wash it away.

quests.instruction: Which dessert is frozen cream and sugar, scooped into flavors like vanilla and chocolate?
quests.hint: It has to stay in the freezer until you eat it.
quests.explanation: Ice cream is made from sweetened cream or milk that is frozen. Pancakes and cake are baked or cooked and stay warm or room temperature.
quests.funFact: Ice cream is stirred while it freezes so the ice crystals stay tiny and it feels smooth.

quests.instruction: Which baked snack is twisted into a knot and sprinkled with salt?
quests.hint: Its shape looks like a pair of folded arms.
quests.explanation: A pretzel is baked bread dough twisted into its special shape, with salt crystals on top.
quests.funFact: Soft pretzels are dipped in a baking-soda mixture before baking, which gives them a shiny brown crust.

quests.instruction: Look for the fruit with a hard, hairy brown shell that holds white flesh and watery liquid inside.
quests.hint: It grows high up on palm trees.
quests.explanation: A coconut's tough shell protects the white flesh and coconut water inside. Pineapples and peaches do not have hard shells.
quests.funFact: Coconuts can float across the sea, which helps coconut palms spread to new beaches.

quests.instruction: What meal has a cooked patty inside a round bun, often with lettuce and tomato slices?
quests.hint: It is stacked in layers.
quests.explanation: A burger is built in layers around a patty, with a bun on the top and bottom.
quests.funFact: A burger patty is often made from ground beef, but it can also be made from beans or vegetables.

quests.instruction: Which food grows as seeds inside pods and is cooked or dried to give us protein?
quests.hint: You can eat them in chili, soups and curries.
quests.explanation: Beans are seeds that grow in pods. They are one of the plant foods that give us protein.
quests.funFact: Beans, peas and lentils all belong to a group of plants called legumes.

quests.instruction: Name the big orange vegetable that grows on a vine and can be cooked into soup or pie.
quests.hint: Its thick wall surrounds a hollow full of seeds.
quests.explanation: A pumpkin is a large vegetable with thick orange flesh. An orange grows on a tree and a watermelon has red flesh.
quests.funFact: Pumpkin seeds can be roasted and eaten as a snack.

quests.instruction: What fruit has fuzzy brown skin outside and bright green flesh with tiny black seeds inside?
quests.hint: You can cut it in half and scoop it out with a spoon.
quests.explanation: A kiwi hides its green flesh under fuzzy skin. A peach has yellow flesh and a banana is pale inside.
quests.funFact: Kiwi fruit were named by New Zealand growers after their national bird, the kiwi.

quests.instruction: Which treat is a small cake baked in a paper cup with frosting swirled on top?
quests.hint: Its size is just right for one person.
quests.explanation: A cupcake is a cake made in a small size, so it bakes in its own paper cup.
quests.funFact: Cupcakes bake faster than a big cake because they are small.

quests.instruction: What food is a fungus with a stem and a rounded cap?
quests.hint: It grows in damp, shady places.
quests.explanation: Mushrooms are fungi, not plants. Only eat mushrooms from a shop or from a trusted adult, because some wild ones are not safe.
quests.funFact: Mushrooms are fungi, a group of living things that is separate from plants and animals.

quests.instruction: Long thin strands of dough are slurped from a bowl of hot broth in many Asian dishes. What are they?
quests.hint: Chopsticks help you lift them.
quests.explanation: Noodles are made from dough that is rolled and cut into strands. Rice and bread are not strands.
quests.funFact: In China, long noodles are often served at birthdays to wish for a long life.

quests.instruction: Which tiny round fruit is blue-purple and has a little star-shaped top?
quests.hint: They are often baked into muffins and pancakes.
quests.explanation: Blueberries are small and round with a star-shaped mark at the top. Grapes have no star, and cherries are red with stems.
quests.funFact: Blueberries grow on bushes, and the star on top is where the flower once was.

quests.instruction: Which fruit has bumpy dark skin, creamy green flesh and one large seed?
quests.hint: It is soft enough to mash onto toast.
quests.explanation: An avocado is creamy inside and has a big seed. A cucumber is crisp and a pear is firm and sweet.
quests.funFact: Avocados ripen after they are picked, so they often feel hard in the store.

quests.instruction: Which food from Japan is made with seasoned rice, often rolled up with vegetables or topped with fish?
quests.hint: It is often eaten with chopsticks.
quests.explanation: Sushi is built around seasoned rice. Pasta is made from wheat dough and pizza from baked bread dough.
quests.funFact: The dark sheet around many sushi rolls is dried seaweed called nori.

quests.instruction: What is a thick, cold drink made by blending fruit with milk, yogurt or juice?
quests.hint: A blender whirls it until it is smooth.
quests.explanation: A smoothie is blended, so it is thicker than juice. Water and milk are not blended with fruit.
quests.funFact: Blending keeps the fruit's fiber, so a smoothie is thicker than juice.

quests.instruction: Which small bulb is split into papery cloves and gives dishes a strong smell and flavor?
quests.hint: Its smell can stay on your fingers.
quests.explanation: Garlic is used to add flavor, and a little goes a long way. Potatoes and tomatoes are used as main ingredients.
quests.funFact: A garlic bulb grows underground, and each clove can grow into a whole new plant.

quests.instruction: Which breakfast food is cooked in a special iron that leaves a grid of little squares on it?
quests.hint: Syrup pools in the squares.
quests.explanation: A waffle is cooked between two patterned plates, which makes its grid. A pancake is smooth and flat.
quests.funFact: Waffles are very popular in Belgium, where some are sold as street food.

quests.instruction: What food is a small pocket of dough filled with meat or vegetables and then steamed or boiled?
quests.hint: It is small enough to eat in a couple of bites.
quests.explanation: A dumpling is dough folded around a filling and sealed shut. A taco is open and pizza is baked flat.
quests.funFact: Many cultures make dumplings, such as Chinese jiaozi, Polish pierogi and Nepali momo.

quests.instruction: Which crunchy vegetable is hollow inside and can be red, yellow, orange or green?
quests.hint: Its seeds cling to a white core in the middle.
quests.explanation: A bell pepper is hollow with a thin crunchy wall. A tomato is filled with juicy pulp and a cucumber is solid.
quests.funFact: A green bell pepper is picked before it is fully ripe, and many turn red if left on the plant.

quests.instruction: Which tiny red fruit grows in pairs on long, thin stems and has a hard pit inside?
quests.hint: The stems make it easy to hold.
quests.explanation: A cherry hangs from a long stem and has one hard pit. A strawberry has no pit and grapes hang in bunches.
quests.funFact: Cherry trees are famous for their spring blossoms, which are celebrated in festivals such as Japan's hanami.

quests.instruction: Which ring-shaped treat has a hole in the middle and often a sweet glaze on top?
quests.hint: Sprinkles often decorate the glaze.
quests.explanation: A donut is a ring of sweet dough that is fried or baked. A cookie is flat and a pretzel is twisted.
quests.funFact: The hole in the middle helps a donut cook evenly all the way through.
